display_name: Terroir Al Limit Les Tosses, Catalunya
raw_content:
{
  "hook": "Les Tosses comes from a single 1.25-hectare parcel of 100-year-old Carignan vines on Priorat's steep slate slopes, where fractured llicorella soil forces roots deep for water. This site delivers iron-laced intensity and grippy tannins that define the wine's savory edge. Terroir al Limit ferments it with whole clusters to highlight that rugged minerality.",
  "wine_summary": "Terroir al Limit pushes Priorat beyond its Garnacha-Cariñena norms by spotlighting old-vine Carignan from tiny, high-elevation plots like Les Tosses. The team—led by Dominik Huber—challenges the DO's yield limits with biodynamic farming on extreme slopes, yielding wines of piercing focus. Those 97-point scores across vintages (2017-2022) reflect consistent extraction of the site's dark fruit and mineral core, setting it apart from broader Priorat blends.",
  "terroir_expression": "Priorat's llicorella—friable slate with quartzite flecks—covers Les Tosses' 600-meter altitude site, reflecting heat by day and radiating it back at night for slow ripening. Continental Mediterranean climate with scant 400mm annual rain stresses old Carignan vines, concentrating iron, graphite, and blackberry flavors while building firm tannins. That geology translates to a metallic tang and earthy persistence in the glass.",
  "vinification_summary": "Hand-harvested grapes undergo whole-cluster carbonic maceration—a process where intact berries ferment intracellularly, softening Carignan's hard tannins and lifting dark fruit aromas—followed by 8 months in neutral oak for the 2022 vintage. Biodynamic practices preserve site-driven purity without heavy extraction. These choices amplify the grape's savory garrigue and olive notes over oak dominance.",
  "food_pairing": "Nashville hot chicken: spice cuts through the wine's grippy tannins while iron matches the crust's savoriness. Lamb tagine with prunes: dried fruit echoes the Carignan's dark plum core, and warm spices align with garrigue herbs. Grilled octopus with romesco: charred tentacles mirror the slate-driven smokiness, romesco's nuts grounding the minerality. Veal shank osso buco: slow-braised richness balances tannic structure, marrow enhancing earthiness. Cheeseburger with aged cheddar: casual melt tempers acidity, beef amplifying black olive depth.",
  "comparable_wines": "Domaine de l'Arjolle Vieilles Vignes Carignan, Languedoc — old-vine focus and iron-mineral profile from schist soils match Les Tosses' savory drive. Clos Mogador Priorat — Priorat peer with Cariñena emphasis, sharing llicorella-derived tannin grip but in a blend format. Calatayud's Pablo Sanz old-vine Carignan — similar altitude stress yields concentrated dark fruit and herbs.",
  "style_profile": "Full-bodied dry Carignan with chewy tannins and iron-laced minerality",
  "cellar_recommendation": "Drink 2022 from 2026 through 2032; earlier vintages like 2019 hit peak now. Store cool at 55°F, low light, on side to keep cork moist.",
  "value_assessment": "$120-160 per bottle positions Les Tosses against Clos Erasmus or Mas Doix single-vineyard cuvées. Those 97-point consistencies beat most competitors' variability. Pay up for the pinpoint terroir if you chase site-specific reds.",
  "market_position": "Sommeliers stock it for tasting menus where Priorat depth elevates modern Catalan cuisine. Collectors chase back vintages through niche importers like Skurnik. Serious wine bar crowds order it to explore Carignan's Priorat potential.",
  "insider_take": "Skip Les Tosses if you want plush New World fruit bombs—its angular slate bite demands patience. People overlook how carbonic maceration tames Carignan's feral side here, revealing layered earth over time. Buy for drinkers who prize old-vine tension.",
  "aging_potential_years": 12,
  "drinking_window_min_years": 2,
  "drinking_window_max_years": 10,
